messages:
isabel: Quick sync: planning a scoped unpin 2.4 -> 2.5 tomorrow 02:30 UTC for non-quant models only. Need host-level exception for quant hosts and a customer-facing note.

cody: Agreed. We'll only unpin generate and chat routes. Keep embed/rerank pinned until SDK uptake / eval passes.

qa: Can we gate by hostname tag 'quant-safe'? If so I'll run a preflight test suite against that set.

isabel: Yes, infra has tags. Cody please apply a host-pin rule for any hostname with tag:quant-safe -> runtime:2.4.

deploybot: Change window scheduled at 1720006200 (02:30 UTC). Canary cohort: can-2-25, 7% traffic for 15m. Roll plan: 7% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m holds.

ops-bot: Rollback triggers: errors >1% sustained 5m OR any OOM on quant hosts -> auto-rollback + sticky-pin. Will post alerts to #eng-oncall.

sdk-team: Heads-up: SDK 1.x clients may not report client_version header. If customers still on 1.x we need to keep embed pinned longer.

cody: Action: enable telemetry tag "client_version" on canary so we can correlate. QA to run embedding similarity check on canary.

qa: Running similarity checks now on canary hostnames. Will report within 25m.

deploybot: Canary metrics @12m: error 0.25%, p95 +11% (longseq subset +28%).

cody: Longseq spike expected; enable longseq batching throttle on canary and re-evaluate.

deploybot: Longseq throttle enabled. Re-run metrics after 10m: error 0.18%, longseq p95 +12%.

qa: Embedding sim check: no statistically significant drift on pinned hosts; non-pinned embeds (small sample) show minor cosine drift <0.5%.

isabel: Decision: proceed to 30% for generate/chat. Embed/rerank remain pinned. Hostname pins for quant-safe applied. Support blurb drafted.

ops-bot: Sticky-pin rule configured: any hostname with tag quant-safe cannot be unpinned. Also auto-sticky-pin if eval-regression alert fires.

deploybot: 30% hold metrics steady. Scheduling full rollout in 3h if stable.

cody: Post-roll tickets: INF-5100 add e2e comparing embed outputs across runtimes; INF-5101 improve client_version propagation.

isabel: Thanks all. Post final rollout I'll push the release note and notify Dedicated customers about embed pin exceptions.

qa: All good from QA. Will keep monitoring for 48h. :thumbsup:

isabel: Closing thread; ping here if any regression alerts.
